note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I’m missing the actual content. The transcript and DDx JSON must be provided to proceed.

Please paste:
- The full clinical transcript (doctor–patient conversation) 
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) as a JSON object

Notes:
- Use American English, concise, professional tone.
- I will extract: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, social history, physical findings, working diagnosis and differentials (from DDx only if consistent with the transcript), management/treatment plan, and follow-up.
- I will apply the exact structure with the sections: Subjective, Objective, Assessment & Plan (with up to 5 issues if applicable), and the quality checks at the end.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If there are conflicts between the transcript and DDx, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”

Once you provide the transcript and DDx JSON, I will generate the complete SOAP note.
